title: Equipment Share of the Contract Value on a Retrofit Project
content:
# Equipment Share of the Contract Value on a Retrofit Project

What portion of a contract value under Equipment Replacement & Retrofit Projects is equipment rather than labor depends on what was bought, and that portion is what the restocking charge is measured against.

## Rule

Where the equipment delivered on the project is a chiller, a boiler or a cooling tower, the equipment share of the contract value is **65 per cent**.

Where the equipment delivered on the project is a rooftop unit, an air handler, a makeup air unit, a VRF system or a computer room unit, the equipment share of the contract value is **55 per cent**.

For every other kind of unit the equipment share of the contract value is half, that is **50 per cent**.

The kind read is the kind of unit recorded on the most recent delivery on the project.

## Shares at a glance

| Kind of unit delivered | Equipment share of the contract value |
|---|---|
| chiller, boiler, cooling tower | 65 per cent |
| rooftop unit, air handler, makeup air unit, VRF system, computer room unit | 55 per cent |
| split system, heat pump, pump, exhaust fan and any other kind | 50 per cent |

Plant equipment carries the highest share because the machine is the greater part of such a job; packaged equipment carries a middle share; anything else is valued at half.

## Worked shares (hypothetical contract value of USD 400000)

A chiller gives an equipment value of USD 260000; an air handler gives USD 220000; a pump gives USD 200000.
